text: Estimates fold changes come uncertainty, noisy estimate shouldn’t look strong precise one. cell_uncertainty takes matrix uncertainties (standard errors, confidence interval widths p-values) colours cells value-suppressing palette: uncertain value, fewer colours part scale closer grey. Precise values use eight colours across scale, four, two, uncertain values single, nearly grey colour. cell_uncertainty_breaks sets thresholds levels, colour legend becomes key one row per level.
code: set.seed(3) genes <- c("IFIT1", "ISG15", "MX1", "OAS1", "IRF7", "STAT1", "CXCL10",            "GBP1", "IL6", "TNF", "CCL2", "NFKBIA", "SOCS3", "JUNB") times <- c("6 h", "12 h", "24 h", "48 h", "72 h", "96 h") # log2 fold changes and their standard errors lfc <- outer(   c(rep(2.4, 7), rep(-1.6, 4), rep(0.6, 3)),   c(0.5, 1, 1.2, 1, 0.7, 0.4) ) + matrix(rnorm(84, 0, 0.5), 14) se <- matrix(rgamma(84, 2, 6), 14) *   rep(c(1, 1, 1, 3, 1, 1, 4, 1, 2.5, 3.5, 1, 1, 5, 1), 6) dimnames(lfc) <- dimnames(se) <- list(genes, times) heat_map(   lfc,   tree_y = TRUE,   cell_col_scale = "Blue-Red 3",   cell_col_scale_limits = c(-3, 3),   cell_uncertainty = se,   cell_uncertainty_breaks = c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9),   cell_uncertainty_title = "SE",   legend_title = "log2 FC",   title = "Fold changes, faded where they're uncertain" )

code: set.seed(7) markers <- c("CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "CD19", "CD56", "CD14") pops <- list(   "CD4 T" = c("CD3", "CD4"),   "CD8 T" = c("CD3", "CD8"),   "B" = "CD19",   "NK" = "CD56",   "Monocyte" = c("CD4", "CD14") ) cluster <- sample(   names(pops),   5000,   replace = TRUE,   prob = c(0.35, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.2) ) events <- matrix(   rnorm(5000 * 6, 0.5, 0.5),   ncol = 6,   dimnames = list(NULL, markers) ) for (p in names(pops)) {   ind <- cluster == p   events[ind, pops[[p]]] <- rnorm(sum(ind) * length(pops[[p]]), 4, 0.6) } heat_map(   heat_map_summarise(events, group_y = cluster, fun = "median"),   cell_col_scale = "viridis",   bar_values_x = events,   bar_type_x = "violin",   bar_size_x = 2,   bar_fill_x = "grey85",   bar_axis_label_x = "All events",   bar_values_y = table(cluster),   bar_fill_y = "grey85",   bar_axis_label_y = "Events",   title = "Median marker intensity per cluster" )

title: HeatmapR
text: addition standard distance metrics supported stats::dist(), HeatmapR also supports cosine distance hierarchical clustering. Cosine distance (1 - cosine similarity) measures angle vectors particularly useful high-dimensional data magnitude vectors less important direction. especially valuable analyzing gene expression data normalized datasets.  Absolute Distance Thresholds: using cosine distance, tree_cut values 0 1 interpreted absolute cosine distance thresholds rather proportional tree heights. example, tree_cut_x = 0.5 means cluster cosine distance 0.5, 50% tree height. provides intuitive control clustering based actual distance values. Correlation distances leaf order: dist_method also accepts "pearson", "spearman" "kendall" one minus correlation, groups rows rise fall together whatever level (common gene expression), function takes matrix clustered returns dist object. dendrogram can drawn many orders, every branch can flipped; tree_order_x tree_order_y choose order. "olo" (optimal leaf ordering) flips branches neighbouring rows similar possible, giving smoother gradients, "mean" orders branches mean values stats::heatmap() .

text: x matrix data.frame containing data display heatmap. scale logical indicating whether data scaled prior constructing heatmap (TRUE scales column). Additional options include "column" "row" indicate whether scaling performed within column row. convenience, name scaling method ("range", "mean" "zscore") can also supplied apply method column. scale_method indicates type scaling perform rows columns indicated scale, options include "range", "mean" "zscore". Set "range" default. dist_method indicates type distance metric use constructing dendrograms, set "euclidean" distance default. See ?dist alternatives. Also supports "cosine" cosine distance (1 - cosine similarity), "pearson", "spearman" "kendall" one minus correlation (common gene expression), function takes matrix clustered (one row per row column heatmap) returns dist object square matrix distances. clust_method indicates type agglomeration method use constructing performing hierarchical clustering, set "complete" default. See ?hclust alternatives. round indicates number decimal places round values cell_text = TRUE values displayed heatmap, set 2 decimal places default tree options include "row", "y", "column", "x" "" (TRUE) indicate axes dendrograms constructed, set FALSE default. argument overrides tree_x tree_y arguments. tree_x logical indicating whether dendrograms constructed x axis (columns), set NULL default.
